node_definition.done_when: Done when. A test leaves a plan review of version N with a complete manifest, no stored record and its promotion waiting, moves the plan to N+1, composes, and reads a new run id that reads N+1. A second test composes while a review of the current version is still working and reads the same run id back. A third test composes while a working review of version N already reads every unit changed in N+1, and reads that same run id back. A negative control that treats any live plan-review pointer without a stored record as in flight returns the old id in the first test. The gate runs on all_debug and its log is written to the section's evidence fragment.
